P.name: Love Tap
P.title: Template:Data Miss Fortune/Love Tap
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Love Tap|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Miss Fortune
|skill        = I
|icon         = Love Tap.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Miss Fortune}} {{tip|basic attacks}} apply a mark that expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Miss Fortune's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to apply a mark that expires upon attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 100 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=50% + 10% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 10% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, halved to {{as|{{pp|key=%|50/2 to 100/2 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=25% + 5% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 5% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = Proc
|parry        = True
|notes        = 
* With {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}, ''Love Tap'' only applies to the primary target.
* The bonus damage applies {{sti|life steal|link=true}}.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against [[buildings]]<!--buildings?-->.
}}

Q.name: Double Up
Q.title: Template:Data Miss Fortune/Double Up
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Double Up|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Miss Fortune
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Double Up.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Miss Fortune}} fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, which then bounces to hit another enemy behind them. This applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit.
|blurb2      = ''Double Up's'' bounce can {{tip|critically strike}}, and does so if ''Double Up'' kills the primary target.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the primary target and {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}}
|description2 = ''Double Up's'' bounce can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}If ''Double Up'' kills the primary target, the bounce will {{tip|critically strike}}.
|description3 = ''The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the bounce.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|7 to 3}}
|cost         = 40
|cast time    = Basic Attack Timer
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tt|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} 550 (+ 100% '''bonus''' {{sti|attack range}})|Always equal to Miss Fortune's attack range}}
|effect radius= 500
|angle        = 160{{degree}}
|speed        = 1400
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = Special
|spelleffects = special
|projectile   = True
|callforhelp  = true
|onhiteffects = True
|parry        = True
|notes        = 
* ''Double Up'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} to both targets, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} can be used by either target. If it is on the primary target, the spell shield will not prevent the shot from bouncing. 
* Neutral units count as valid targets to bounce.
* The bounce follows a priority order on targets behind in a certain angle:
*# 500 units in 20º.
*# 500 units in 40º.
*# 500 units in 110º.
*# {{tt|150 units|Estimated}} in 160º.
* ''Double Up's'' cast range adjusts based on '''Miss Fortune's''' {{sti|attack range}}, which can be increased by items such as {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}.
* The damage of a {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}} shot is {{ap|20*1.5 to 120*1.5}} {{as|(+ 150% AD)}} {{as|(+ 52.5% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{ap|20*1.65 to 120*1.65}} {{as|(+ 165% AD)}} {{as|(+ 57.75% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} by {{iis|Infinity Edge}} bonus critical damage.
* If there is no secondary target, the shot will not bounce and the dud will instead fall to the ground.
** The dud lands on the ground 176 units behind the primary target and has a missile speed of 400 on its way there.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
}}

R.name: Bullet Time
R.title: Template:Data Miss Fortune/Bullet Time
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Bullet Time|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Miss Fortune
|skill        = R
|icon         = Bullet Time.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Miss Fortune}} {{tip|channel|channels}} for a short time, firing several waves of bullets in the target direction that deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Each wave can {{tip|critically strike}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, firing a number of waves of bullets in the target direction. Each wave is in a spread of 6 projectiles that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage per Wave|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 60% AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Waves|{{ap|14 to 18}}|Maximum Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*14 to 40*18}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*14 to 60*18}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*14 to 25*18}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Wave Interval Time|{{ap|2.85/(14 to 18)|round=4}} seconds}}
|description2 = Each of the waves can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|130|30}}|critical damage}} damage.
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 100}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time = {{fd|0.001}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|effect radius= {{tt|1450|Range of each bullet stream}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly=true}} {{tt|40|Width of each bullet stream}}
|speed        = 2000
|angle        = {{tt|30{{degree}}|The effective angle is wider based the width of the missile streams + enemy size}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = False
|spelleffects = aoedot
|projectile   = True
|silence      = true
|notes        = 
* The damage dealt by each wave of ''Bullet Time'' is calculated when the wave reaches the target.
* '''Miss Fortune''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} a 200-radius area around herself for {{fd|2.0}} seconds to the enemy team if she fires from an unseen location and there is one of their units within the target cone of {{pending for test}} 1400 units radius and 17{{degree}} cone (toward either side from her facing direction), and repeatedly as she fires waves while enemies are in a cone of {{pending for test}} 1500 units radius and 23{{degree}} cone (toward either side from her facing direction) in front of her.
* Targets cannot be damaged by more than one projectile per wave.
* The bullet streams that each fire 1 projectile per wave are spead by 6{{degree}} between one another, aiming towards the angles +-3/9/15{{degree}} from '''Miss Fortune's''' facing direction.
* ''Bullet Time'' picks 6 locations on the ground 500 units from '''Miss Fortune''' (with the aforementioned angles) and fires a bullet stream towards each.
** If '''Miss Fortune''' is moved to a new location, these locations '''will''' update (since patch [[V13.3]]); the cone will fire towards her new facing direction.
* The unusually short [[cast time]] of ''Bullet Time'' will result in an effective cast time of {{rutngt|0.001}}, as the server must wait until the next game tick for the channel time to start.
** '''Miss Fortune''' is allowed to cast {{si|Flash}} during this ''cast time''. As {{si|Flash}} changes the user's facing direction, this will cause ''Bullet Time'' to fire in the new facing direction.
*** Casting {{si|Flash}} before the cast time will not affect the cast direction (''Bullet Time'' will correctly fire towards the targeted location on the ground). 
* ''Bullet Time'' fires the first wave at {{rutngt|0.05}}, and the last at {{rutngt|2.9}}. Times between waves are equally spread between these values.
** '''Miss Fortune''' may cancel the last ~{{fd|0.1}} seconds of channel time at no loss of effect.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Miss Fortune''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|cast=interrupts|move=interrupts|items=interrupts,true,,false|consume=true|spells=true,interrupts,interrupts,interrupts,interrupts}}
}}
